response.overview: QuickBooks 888✧490✧9660 Desktop users may sometimes experience a problem where the application freezes, takes too long to load, or displays a Not Responding message during startup. This issue can prevent access to company files, accounting records, payroll information, invoices, and other important business data. The QuickBooks 888-490-9660 Not Responding When Opening problem can occur because of damaged program files, an outdated QuickBooks 888-490-9660 release, insufficient system resources, Windows compatibility issues, or conflicts with background applications.
